sourceFacts.assignment: handler assigns one uniform P001..P013 to native HERO or n208, after registration/stop/mana refill; permanent flag does not prove unconditional B015
sourceFacts.noLossCallback: Only three literal B015 queries in business Lua: two pickup branches, one level-up branch; no literal script removes B015 on prerequisite loss
sourceFacts.upgradeGate: mode!=2 and level>20 and B015<=0 -> strip level-20; A225/T299 before gate, W019 after gate
sourceFacts.pickupGate: mode!=2, not box/worker, item level>3, not ignore_strong_item instance; ordinary bear companion reads linked Tower_ALL owner unless A_ITEM_ID; otherwise recipient B015
sourceFacts.existingGearAndLevels: Source contains no B015-loss event to strip levels or force existing items out; only subsequent specified events check it

webSelections.authority: Q24, researched native prerequisite and aura timing; not original client measurement
webSelections.requiredUnit: At least one existing alive completed non-illusion unit of exact required type owned by the qualified unit owner; cards/unfinished buildings/allies/corpses do not count
webSelections.qualificationHolder: exists, alive, visible, enabled positive P001-P013; self-only, native HERO not required (n208 supported); invulnerability/magic immunity allowed
webSelections.temporaryEmissionSuppression: hidden/invisible/illusion/hex/burrow source suppresses this aura contribution; stun/silence/pause do not independently suppress it
webSelections.recompute: immediate after relevant committed owner/type/completion/life/ability/state change; zero linger, no extra RNG/timer; exact-current-type requirement
webSelections.stacking: any qualifying held P001-P013 yields one B015 contribution; independent explicit external contributions retained
webSelections.extraStats: none: no native stock Endurance move/attack bonus inherited from missing DataA/B
webSelections.onLoss: remove qualification contribution only; do not alter current level/XP/items, no synthetic level-up/pickup event; later events follow existing script
webSelections.deathAndRevival: permanent qualification id retained if same logical entity; B015 contribution absent while dead, recomputed on revival; no reroll
webSelections.dispel: ordinary magic dispel does not remove this aura; explicit rawcode removal executes then recomputes from still-valid emitters
webSelections.save: persist selected ability, actual providers and event position; rebuild derived B015 without replaying random assignment or level-up
webSelections.repeatedActualHandler: not silently deduplicated; if legitimately called again, preserve source registration/random/add behavior

primaryEvidence.supports: self-benefit, universal auras, nonstacking and hidden/invisible emission; does not settle this custom prerequisite lifecycle

remaining: full native unit-upgrade technology accounting uses placement/upgrade transaction integration
hero natural stat and learned-skill rollback on UnitStripHeroLevel
full bear companion identity/lifecycle and all item pickup branches
matched-client evidence for chosen native prerequisite/aura timing
